positioning: ZAUQ is an AI personal stylist for the clothes you ALREADY own. It lays out a daily outfit from your wardrobe, renders any look on your own photo, and keeps a wear journal so nothing sits unworn. The enemy is not other apps — it is the full-closet-nothing-to-wear morning, and the guilt of clothes worn once. Every ad sells the same feeling: you already own your next favourite outfit, and getting dressed can feel like having a stylist.

concepts.d: 6s Reel. Black screen, gold serif types out 'ZAUQ · ذوق · noun — taste.' Cut to three fast outfit reveals on a phone (the Mirror rendering looks on a real photo). End card: 'Your personal stylist. myzauq.com'. Sound: a single elegant piano note + a soft chime per outfit.

9:16 native/UGC. Phone-shot POV of someone staring into a packed closet, sighing. Text overlay: 'POV: it's 8am and you have nothing to wear (again).' Swipe — the ZAUQ app lays out a full look from those exact clothes. 'I never say it anymore.' Feels organic, not an ad.

5-frame carousel. F1: '43 pieces.' F2: '= 1,200 possible outfits.' F3: 'You wear about 10.' F4: A styled look (image). F5: 'ZAUQ wears the rest for you. → myzauq.com'. Screenshot-simple, stops the scroll with a number.
Split 4:5. Left: chaotic closet, muted. Right: one perfect outfit spotlit on a hanger. Caption: 'Same closet. Two minutes apart.' The ZAUQ arch mark bridges the two halves.

Static 1:1 that looks like a shopping receipt on dark paper: 'ITEMS OWNED 47 / WORN THIS MONTH 9 / UNWORN 38 / — / ZAUQ: styles all 47.' The 'ugly ad' that reads as information, not marketing. Great for cold audiences.

8s screen-recording. A user taps two closet pieces → the Mirror renders the outfit on their photo → they smile and tap 'Wearing it today.' Text: 'See it on you before you wear it.' Proof-of-product; strongest for warm/retargeting.

4:5 quote card in the brand: a real-sounding line — '‘I stopped buying clothes I already own.’' — set in Bodoni over an atelier background, small ZAUQ mark. Rotate 3-4 quotes for social proof once you have users.
1:1, pure type on the atelier texture: 'Stop shopping.' (beat) 'Start wearing.' Minimal, bold, brand-forward. Pair with the softest, most beautiful background. Brand awareness + curiosity.

formats: Feed 4:5 (1080x1350) gets the most screen and is the default for cold traffic. Square 1:1 (1080x1080) for feed variety and the receipt/type ads. Story/Reel 9:16 (1080x1920) for Stories placements and as static Reel covers. Every headline here fits Meta's fields; the on-image copy and the Ads-Manager copy reinforce, never repeat verbatim.
howto: In Meta Ads Manager: upload the image, paste Primary Text and Headline from the card, set the CTA button, and point the URL at myzauq.com. Start with 3-4 angles per audience, one image each, and let the decision-fatigue and 'already in your closet' angles lead — they test best for a styling product. Kill losers after ~2-3 days, scale the winner's angle with fresh images from the same background library.
